steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ Responses screen with Vendor A's bid.
Enable eRFX projects as required for the RFQ flow.
Apply the required RFQ counter-offer visibility configuration.
Apply the required bidding-time rejection configuration.
Enable the required buyer bid-editing configuration.
Enable the required percentage counter-offer configuration.
Select Convert to Auction from the RFQ Settings menu.
Verify that the conversion prompt or menu opens and lists Continue.
